description: Returns a sent email (`msg_` id) as an RFC 822 message rebuilt from what is stored: its headers and its HTML or text body, without attachments. For a received email (`rcv_` id) only the header block comes back (the original headers when the raw email was kept, else ones rebuilt from what is stored): its body reaches a model only as text, through mails_get_received. Text past 100,000 characters is cut short.
name: mails_emails_raw
title: Get an email as RFC 822
